description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application implementing an effective navigation pattern. It manages a ViewPager with tabs, sets up fragments for different sections, and handles navigation interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the navigation tabs and fragments for the app.

classes.name: AppSectionsPagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter providing fragments for each primary section of the application.

classes.name: LaunchpadSectionFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing the launchpad section with buttons navigating to other activities.

classes.name: DummySectionFragment
classes.description: Placeholder fragment displaying dummy text for additional sections.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the ViewPager and tabs, and links them together.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Empty handler for tab unselection events.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Handles tab selection changes, updates the ViewPager to the selected page.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Empty handler for tab reselection events.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the fragment for the given section index.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of primary sections (3).

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Provides the title for the tab corresponding to the given position.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates and sets up the fragment's view, including button click handlers.
